subject: grad
title: GRAD.------DOC.
description: Chart on book p. 295 (WI-11). GRAD (gradualism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; DOC (documentation) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). From CULT-INFO-F: DEF (definition) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From DEF: INFO-INTR (information interpretation). From PHY-U-P: TRS (transition). From INFO-INTR: INT (intention). From TRS: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From INT: POL-SIGN (political significance). From RT-DY: PART (participation).
